def: to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp (figuratively)

occurrences.text: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
And he wrote a letter after this manner:
Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
